visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male athlete with dark hair, wearing a gray and orange sports jersey, is seated on a wooden bench in a sports dugout. He is intently looking down at a rectangular orange and black sign featuring a cartoon Shiba Inu and Chinese characters. His facial expression is one of curiosity and slight confusion as he holds the sign with both hands. The background consists of a row of red stadium seats and a wall with several baseball bats leaning against it. (2) The man lifts the sign higher and looks toward someone off-camera, his brow slightly furrowed in an inquisitive look. He then begins to smile as he listens to the person off-camera. The lighting is bright and consistent, characteristic of an indoor sports facility. He holds a black baseball bat against his legs with his left hand while gesturing slightly with the sign. (3) He looks directly into the camera lens with a warm and friendly smile. He speaks while holding the sign and the bat, nodding his head slightly. His hand gestures are subtle as he communicates. The framing is a medium shot, capturing his upper body and the immediate surroundings of the dugout, including the red chairs and wooden slats of the bench.
